answer: Escrowed Reputation Decay Pricing: each new identity must escrow a fee that decays only as its unique interaction history grows, so a sonnet of fresh accounts cannot borrow trust. Enforcement reads a vertex of transaction diversity per identity; low-diversity identities pay the full escrow on every action, while established ones pay near zero. An attacker minting thousands of identities pays that full escrow across an ocean of accounts, making each fake cost real capital locked for months.
